answer: Gate payouts behind a per-identity stake that must sit on a cold marble ledger for several epochs before any reward unlocks. Peers only release the stake after they attest a violet work trail unique to that address; shared or recycled trails never clear the same ledge. A Sybil therefore pays the full stake and wait for every fake account, so spinning up ten thousand identities costs ten thousand stakes and months of idle capital with no shared unlock.
